## Context / immutable basis

Edit only those blocks to remove chronology, repetition, narration, or separator ornament while retaining current contracts.

## Exact allowlist — 38 blocks

- test_conformance.py (6): module docstring 1-22; comments 41-43 and 88-95; test_harness_boundary_failure_modes docstring 127-132; test_worker_boundary_failure_modes docstring 374-378; comment 414-416.

- test_non_adoption.py (7): module docstring 1-17; comments 48-50, 59-60, 83-84, 100, 122-123, and 145-146.

The first nine files retain their prior 34-block inventory; test_terraform_corroborator.py contributes four independently validated comment regions, producing 38 blocks across 10 paths.

## Preservation boundaries
Preserve backend/failure coverage, closed abstention reasons, worker isolation/reaping, detector quarantine and attribution, validation deduplication/fan-out, confirm-only dependency/environment resolution, import-clean non-adoption, polyglot collision/member/workspace/alias/stdlib guards, deterministic extraction, yield floors, and zero false refutes.

For test_terraform_corroborator.py preserve positive-only corroboration, read-only snapshot isolation, relative position/path safety, redaction, retry/cleanup, and closed abstention. Keep its concise module docstring at line 1; mechanism marker at line 23; generated runtime-string shebang at 104 and comment payload at 131-136; concise baseline comment at 322; and every other unlisted comment unchanged. The generated script text is runtime content.

Preserve all runtime strings and every physical directive line. At the basis those are the mechanism-ok/noqa line in test_terraform_corroborator.py and three type: ignore[arg-type] lines in test_harness.py. The '# noqa: BLE0001' text inside the editable test_worker_entry_propagates_interrupts docstring is prose, not a source directive. Also preserve the concise import/distribution guard at test_polyglot_corpus.py:223-224 and yield calibration at test_yield_eval.py:42-44.

## Implementation and review
Capture immutable before/final blobs. For Python, parse with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True), replace only the allowlisted leading owner docstrings, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. The zero-context hunk oracle permits changes only inside the listed base spans; the directive/shebang oracle compares protected physical lines. Do not change adjacent blank lines.

A non-author reviewer posts exactly 38 leaf-linked TSV rows:
stable_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>final_words<TAB>semantic_preservation<TAB>bloat_removal<TAB>reviewer_session
Citations use full SHAs; every final word count is smaller and all three verdicts are PASS.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 38 allowlisted blocks change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its stated current contract.
- [ ] The immutable-base AST/runtime, protected-line, and base-span oracle passes for all 10 paths.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the 10 file-impact paths.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 38 complete PASS rows with immutable citations.
- [ ] All seven structured commands and the concrete commands below exit 0.

## Verification
The persisted immutable-prose-only command contains the exact owner/span map and is authoritative for semantic and comment boundaries. Run it, then run this literal zsh session from the leaf worktree:

~~~zsh
R=tests/unit/grounding
paths=(
$R/test_conformance.py
$R/test_coverage_reconstruction.py
$R/test_engine_b.py
$R/test_environment_resolution.py
$R/test_harness.py
$R/test_non_adoption.py
$R/test_polyglot_corpus.py
$R/test_resolve.py
$R/test_terraform_corroborator.py
$R/test_yield_eval.py
)
rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -c 'import subprocess,sys
expected=sorted(sys.argv[1:]); actual=sorted(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","HEAD^..HEAD"],text=True).splitlines())
if actual!=expected: raise SystemExit((actual,expected))' "${paths[@]}"
rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest -q "${paths[@]}"
rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" ruff check "${paths[@]}"
rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" ruff format --check "${paths[@]}"
rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py
rtk git diff --check HEAD^..HEAD -- "${paths[@]}"
rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify
~~~
